## Blog & Technical Articles
Jorge writes technical articles about full stack development, performance optimization, embedded systems, and AI.

Blog URL: https://jorgemopanc.com/blog

### Recent Articles
- [The Six Cache Layers Every Developer Should Understand](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/cache-layers-every-developer-should-know) - Maps all six caching layers from in-process memory to edge CDN nodes, with production patterns.
- [CCTalk Serial Protocol in Embedded C](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/cctalk-embedded-c-concurrency-bus-arbitration) - Implementing half-duplex serial protocol in embedded C: race conditions, ISR timing, and real-world traps.
- [Processing 900k Records in 2 Hours: Bounded Concurrency in Node.js](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/processing-900k-records-nodejs-bounded-concurrency) - Streaming generators, bounded concurrency with p-limit, worker threads, and checkpointing.
- [The AI Multiplier Effect: How LLMs Are Quietly Reshaping Software Teams](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/ai-multiplier-effect-software-teams) - First-hand observations on AI coding tools and their real impact on developer productivity.
- [TIL: Five Async Node.js Patterns That Changed How I Write Promises](https://jorgemopanc.com/blog/five-async-nodejs-patterns-promises) - Promise.allSettled, AbortController, async iterators, concurrency limiters, and error boundaries.
